1:4.en: 190 In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, are signs for people of understanding. 191 They remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and they reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: “Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” 192 “Our Lord, anyone You admit to the Fire is truly disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.” 193 “Our Lord, we heard a caller inviting people to faith: ‘Believe in your Lord,’ and we believed. Our Lord, forgive our sins, erase our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous.” 194 “Our Lord, grant us what You promised through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break Your promise.” 195 Their Lord answered them: “I will never let the work of any of you be lost, whether male or female; you are from one another. I will erase the misdeeds of those who emigrated, were driven from their homes, were harmed in My cause, fought, or were killed, and I will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow—a reward from Allah. With Allah is the finest reward.” 196 Do not be deceived by the freedom with which the disbelievers move through the land. 197 It is only a brief enjoyment; then Hell will be their home—and what a miserable resting place. 198 But those who are mindful of their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will remain: a welcome from Allah. What is with Allah is better for the righteous. 199 Among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah, in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They humble themselves before Allah and do not trade Allah’s revelations for a small price. Their reward is with their Lord; Allah is swift in reckoning. 200 Believers, be steadfast, outdo one another in steadfastness, remain ready, and be mindful of Allah so that you may succeed.
1:4.tl: Inna fī khalqi as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa ikhtilāfi l-layli wa an-nahāri lāyātin lʾūlī l-ʾlbābi alladhīna yadhkurūna llāha qiyāman wa quʿūdan wa ʿalaya junūbihim wa yatafakkarūna fī khalqi as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan subḥānaka fa qinā ʿadhāba an-nāri rabbanā innaka man tudkhili an-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā li-lẓẓālimīna min anṣārin rrabbanā innanā samiʿnā munādīan yunādī li-lʾīmāni an āminū bi-rabbikum fa āmannā rabbanā fa ighfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir ʿannā sayyiʾātinā wa tawaffanā maʿa l-ʾbrāri rabbanā wa ātinā mā wa ʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukhzinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukhlifu l-mīʿāda fa istajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilin mminkum mmin dhakarin aw unthā baʿḍukum mmin baʿḍin fa alladhīna hājarū wa ukhrijū min diyārihim wa ūdhū fī sabīlī wa qātalū wa qutilū lʾukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiʾātihim wa lʾudkhilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru thawāban mmin ʿindi llāhi wa-llāhu ʿindahu ḥusnu ath-thawābi lā yaghurrannaka taqallubu alladhīna ka-fa rū fī l-bilādi matāʿun qalīlun thumma maʾwāhum jahannamu wa biʾsa l-mihādu lākini alladhīna ttaqaw rabbahum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā nuzulan mmin ʿindi llāhi wamā ʿinda llāhi khayrun llilʾabrāri waʾinna min ahli l-kitābi laman yuʾminu bi-llāhi wamā unzila ilaykum wamā unzila ilayhim khāshiʿīna li-llāhi lā yashtarūna bi-āyāti llāhi thamanan qalīlan ūlaʾika lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim inna llāha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū iṣbirū wa ṣābirū wa rābiṭū wāttaqū llāha laʿallakum tufliḥūn
1:4.diff: رسم الألف وعنوان «سورة آل عمران» في نصنا

25:1.en: I ask Allah for forgiveness. O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.
25:1.tl: Astaghfiru llāh Allāhumma anta as-salāmu, wa minka as-salāmu, tabārakta yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrām

25:2.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no wealth or status can benefit its possessor against You.
25:2.tl: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, walā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, walā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jaddu

25:6.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected. Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
25:6.tl: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾ wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm

36:1.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.
36:1.tl: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-ʿaẓīmu l-ḥalīmu, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu as-samawāti warabbu l-ʾarḍi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm

38:1.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.
38:1.tl: Allāhumma rbba as-samawāti as-sabʿi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, kun lī jāran min fulāni bni fulānin, wa aḥzābihi min khalāʾiqika, an yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, ʿazza jāruka, wajalla thanāʾuka, walā ilāha illā ant

38:2.en: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.
38:2.tl: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu aʿazzu min khalqihi jamīʿan, allāhu aʿazzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdharu, aʿūdhu bi-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-mumsiki as-samawāti as-sabʿi an yaqaʿna ʿalā l-ʾarḍi illā bi-idhnihi, min sharri ʿabdika fulānin, wa junūdihi wa atbāʿihi wa ashyāʿihi, min al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi, allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanāʾuka waʿazza jāruka, wa tabāraka ismuka, walā ilāha ghayruk

55:1.en: O Allah, forgive {{deceasedName}} and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.
55:1.tl: Allāhumma ighfir li-{{deceasedName}} wa irfaʿ darajatahu fī l-mahdiyyīna, wa ikhlufhu fī ʿaqibihi fī l-ghābirīna, wa ighfir lanā walahu yā rabba l-ʿālamīna, wa ifsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fīh

57:2.en: O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and increase their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, and protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of Hell. Grant him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who died before us, and those who preceded us in faith.
57:2.tl: Allāhumma ijʿalhu fa raṭan wa dhukhran li-wa ad-dayhi, wa shafīʿan mujāban, allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā, wa aʿẓim bihi ujwrahumā, wa alḥiqhu bi-ṣāliḥi l-muʾminīna, wa ijʿalhu fī ka-fa-l-ti ibrāhīma, waqihi bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, allāhumma ighfir li-aslāfinā, wa afrāṭinā, waman sabaqanā bi-l-ʾīmān
57:2.diff: كلام الراوي «وإن قال… فحسن» في نصنا

97:1.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family. We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.
97:1.tl: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl Āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbinā ḥāmidūn
97:1.diff: «وإذا رجع قالهن وزاد فيهن» كلام الراوي

118:1.en: Our Lord, give us what is good in this world and what is good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
118:1.tl: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī l-ʾākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāba an-nār

129:1.en: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. I take refuge from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. I take refuge from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.
129:1.tl: Aʿūdhu bkalimāti llāhi at-tāmmāti allatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun walā fājirun: min sharri mā khalaqa, wa baraʾa wa dharaʾa, wamin sharri mā yanzilu mina as-samāʾi, wamin sharri mā yaʿruju fyhā, wamin sharri mā dharaʾa fī l-ʾarḍi, wamin sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wamin sharri fitani l-layli wa an-nahāri, wamin sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bi-khayrin yā raḥmān
